text:
The European Court of Human Rights held that the UK did not violate Article 6(1) when its courts barred Mr Al-Adsani's torture damages claim against Kuwait on state immunity grounds, so the immunities were not in conflict with the right to a fair trial. The Grand Chamber decided this by a 9 to 8 majority, finding that the immunity pursued a legitimate aim and was proportionate. I'm less sure of the 9 to 8 split and the Article 3 and 13 findings from my earlier answer, so check those against the judgment.

CONFIDENCE: 85
